captures.description: AI Mode result, 3 sites (all Amazon.in). 'Jack Feist is the subject of Paper Roses: The Imaginary Archive of a Canonical Life, a unique literary project presented as a found biography.' About the Project: Concept — 'a sprawling poetry and fiction project that pieces together the archive of a life using found poems, journals, letters, and fragments'; The Subject — 'books center on the late American poet Jack Feist, portraying his personal history and writings as an exercise in capturing an interior life'; Philosophy quote — 'I shall be the Jack Feist of our future, a private interior of written letters: history expressed in my cluttered bedroom.' Key Volumes: 'What Was Lost (Books 1-3).' The composition layer reifies Paper Roses as a commercially-published series — all three source citations are Amazon.in. Strong basin: 14 archive deposits canonically link Jack Feist to Paper Roses and to All That Lies Within Me.
